title: Repository CI throughput optimisation realisation
purpose: Realise the fastest safe GitHub CI throughput improvements that preserve USF semantic authority, validator discipline, proof evidence integrity, planted-defect coverage, proof-cockpit freshness, branch-protection clarity, and non-claims.

candidateMatrix.candidate: dependency caching for pnpm store and pip downloads
candidateMatrix.safetyBoundary: Caches only package-manager stores and download wheels. It does not cache node_modules, site-packages, virtualenvs, proof evidence, generated reports, Compose state, secrets, or proof payloads. Pull-request runs restore caches read-only; main runs may write caches.
Affected-domain output remains warn-only. Unknown, workflow, package, lockfile, validator, evidence, proof-cockpit, provider-mode, or environment ambiguity falls back to full validation.

candidateMatrix.reason: Branch protection currently requires the single validate status check. Replacing broad PR validation with an affected-only or split gate needs equivalent fallback proof and a separate owner decision.

candidateMatrix.candidate: validator and test sharding or parallelisation
candidateMatrix.reason: Existing governance requires serial-versus-parallel equivalence, deterministic output paths, resource locks, and shared-resource analysis before parallel execution becomes default.

candidateMatrix.safetyBoundary: Only superseded pull-request validate-spec runs are cancellable. Main validate-spec runs and proof-anchor publication are not cancelled by this change.

candidateMatrix.reason: A new workflow surface is not needed for the measured bottleneck and would require additional authorised workflow naming and status-context analysis.

candidateMatrix.implementedBy: existing proof-cockpit squash-stable source-tree hash posture from PR 331, this artefact's freshness boundary, and a proof-review re-pin after non-proof source changes
candidateMatrix.safetyBoundary: This change records proof-cockpit re-pin as required for the changed non-proof source tree, does not treat generated reports as authority, and does not make branch commits load-bearing where the non-proof tree is equivalent.

candidateMatrix.candidate: Caddy or callback CI throughput changes
candidateMatrix.reason: No CI throughput bottleneck requires changing Caddy, public proof routes, callback payload handling, webhook payload handling, or proof cockpit access surfaces. Callback payloads are not authority.
Self-hosted runners require owner decisions for trust boundary, cache isolation, local state, secret handling, maintenance, evidence collection, and GitHub branch-protection posture.
Larger runners may reduce wall time but introduce cost and repository policy decisions. No correctness or evidence claim can be derived from larger runner capacity alone.

candidateMatrix.safetyBoundary: Cache reuse is diagnostic acceleration only. No CI artifact reuse is introduced, no generated report is promoted to authority, and no cache hit can satisfy validation or proof by itself.

candidateMatrix.candidate: scheduled, nightly, or manual deep jobs
candidateMatrix.reason: Current branch protection requires validate on PR and main. Moving required coverage to schedule or manual dispatch would weaken the gate without a separate owner decision and equivalence proof.

candidateMatrix.safetyBoundary: The GitHub step summary is generated diagnostic evidence only. It does not define semantics, proof readiness, performance budget compliance, or acceptance.

allowedCacheScopes: pnpm store path resolved by corepack pnpm store path --silent

mandatoryFallbackClasses: proof evidence or generated report change

proofCockpitFreshnessBoundary.currentChurnControl: squash-stable non-proof source-tree hash posture from PR 331
proofCockpitFreshnessBoundary.reasonRePinRequired: The validate-spec workflow and repository-optimisation artefact changes are part of the non-proof source tree used by proof-cockpit freshness checks. A proof-review re-pin is required after the final non-proof source tree is committed.

callbackAndCaddyDecision.reason: CI throughput optimisation is achieved inside validate-spec workflow setup and reporting. No callback route, Caddy route, webhook payload, public proof route, or Compose service needs to change.

timingEvidence.baselineSource: GitHub Actions validate-spec workflow runs observed on 2026-07-09

validationPlan: Strict JSON parse for created and modified JSON files.
GitHub pull-request validate-spec run records after timing and cache hit or miss evidence.
nonClaims: No staging, deployment, provider, credential, store, production, live-provider, compliance, monetisation, or human-acceptance claim is made.
No generated report is semantic authority.
No callback payload is semantic authority.
No self-hosted runner local state is semantic authority.
No proof-cockpit freshness rule is weakened.
No implementation/runtime source code is created.
